IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Saturday 7 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres around midday.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Sunday 8 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots shifting southeasterly in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Monday 9 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming easterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending northeasterly during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Tuesday 10 November
Winds: North to northeasterly about 10 knots tending easterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending northeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Sunny.
IDT12420.synoptic: A cold southwesterly wind flow developed over the State in the wake of a front and will persist on Saturday. Another high pressure system moves close to Tasmania on Sunday, drifting away to the southeast from Monday. A trough is expected to approach from the west on Tuesday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Saturday 7 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 25 knots.
Seas: 1.5 to 2 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail.

Sunday 8 November
Winds: South to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending south to southeasterly below 10 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy.

Monday 9 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming northeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres near Cape Bruny during the afternoon or evening.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Cloudy.
